entries.note: Percent-decode once, reject control bytes and nonlocal URI authorities, separate a positive source location, match absolute paths to the originating terminal root on a segment boundary, then normalize relative dot segments without escaping that root. The service still enforces canonical-path/symlink and regular-file boundaries. Root switching and tab movement must never substitute the active project. Existing editor buffers are focused without reloading or writing them.

Cmd/Ctrl-click is a local open-file gesture; consume both mouse press and release so an agent with negotiated mouse tracking never receives half a click. Ordinary input and hover retain the terminal protocol. A modifier hover discloses the target in the status bar. The opening session and its process remain alive.
